subject: Risk & retention qualification — next steps + docs
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Williams <ava.williams@finedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Risk & retention qualification — next steps + docs

Hi Ava — great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on security/compliance items for FineEdge evaluation of Redwood:

Summary of pain points we heard
- You need demonstrable audit logs and retention controls for user activity across inference requests (demo data retention, deletion workflows).
- SOC 2 Type II evidence will be requested by your InfoSec team as part of procurement.
- Pen test reports and third-party scan evidence are expected for production PII/financial workloads.
- Legal wants a DPA with clear retention/erasure timelines and an answer on subprocessor lists.

Goals we discussed
- Confirm Redwood can provide: SOC 2 Type II report, redacted sample audit logs, and a standard DPA (we can accept reasonable redlines).
- Clarify default retention periods and deletion APIs for cached inputs/KV cache in private and hosted deployments.
- Identify next meeting with InfoSec (technical deep dive) and Procurement (contract timeline).

What I'm attaching
- SOC2_Type2_Q3-2026.pdf — our most recent independent Type II report (redacted).
- audit-log-sample.csv — sanitized example of the audit events we can provide (timestamp, request_id, model, user_id hash, action).
- DPA_redline_v3.docx — our standard DPA with common redlines we accept.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the InfoSec attendees and a 60-minute slot next week for a technical deep dive? (We suggest Tue/Wed afternoons PDT.)
2) Procurement: please confirm if the DPA redline is the right starting point, or if you prefer to send your markups.
3) Which retention window do you need for audit logs (30 / 90 / 365 days)? We can scope archiving/long-term export if needed.

I'll coordinate with Marissa to prepare a short demo (KV cache behavior and deletion flow) and have Rishi bring the SOC2/pen-test policy details.

Thanks again — I'll follow up with a calendar invite once we have a time.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Diego: (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Q3-2026.pdf, audit-log-sample.csv, DPA_redline_v3.docx

From: Ava Williams <ava.williams@finedge.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@finedge.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Risk & retention qualification — next steps + docs

Thanks Diego — appreciate the concise recap and the artifacts. A few clarifying items before we loop InfoSec:

— Retention: for audit logs we are aiming for 365 days searchable, with the option to export to our long-term SIEM. Is bulk export available via S3 or FTP?
— DPA: Procurement will take your DPA and return a marked version. Please note we have a standard clause about subprocessor notification windows (30 days).
— Pen test evidence: our Security Ops wants the scope and date for the latest external pen test. Is that included in the SOC2 appendix or is it a separate report?

If you can confirm export options and pen test scope today, we can pick attendees and propose slots. Prefer Wed 14 Apr 10:00-11:00 PDT for the technical deep dive.

Appreciate it — I'll also add our head of Security (cc'd procurement) once we have the timing.

Best,
Ava Williams
Head of Platform Security, FineEdge
ava.williams@finedge.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Risk & retention qualification — next steps + docs

Diego / Rishi — action items I can take now so we respond to Ava before EOD:
1) Retention & export: We support 365-day searchable audit logs. Export: yes — we can schedule an S3 export job or provide a gzipped CSV via pre-signed S3 link. For private deployments we can push to a customer-managed S3 or provide a one-time bulk export.
2) Pen test: Our most recent external pentest was performed by SecureWave in 2026-11. We include a 1-page executive summary in the SOC2 appendix; full report is vendor-controlled and we can provide a redacted copy under NDA. I'll pull the pentest scope and date into a short slide.
3) DPA redlines: I've reviewed DPA_redline_v3.docx. The subprocessor notification window — we typically 30-day notice for material changes and can accept FineEdge's clause with minor edits. I'll prepare a companion cover note for Procurement explaining our point-by-point stance.

Planned next steps (internal)
- I'll produce a 2-slide artifact: 1) where audit logs live + retention/export options + sample CSV mapping; 2) pen test summary + how to request the redacted report under NDA.
- Rishi: can you prepare the pen-test executive summary extract (one paragraph + scope bullets) and confirm whether SOC2 appendix includes the SecureWave engagement letter?
- Diego: I'll draft the reply to Ava and attach the export options + slide.

ETA: draft reply to Ava by 5pm PDT today.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Williams <ava.williams@finedge.com>, procurement@finedge.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Risk & retention qualification — next steps + docs

Ava — quick follow and confirmation per Marissa / Rishi's notes (quoted below):

— Retention & export: We can support 365 days of searchable audit logs. Export options: scheduled S3 export (customer-owned bucket with pre-signed role), ad-hoc pre-signed S3 link (gzipped CSV), or webhook delivery for stream-to-SIEM. We'll attach a short export/format spec in the meeting.

— Pen test: SecureWave performed the external pentest on 2026-11-18. We include a summary in the SOC2 appendix; the full redacted report is available under NDA. We'll bring the one-paragraph summary and engagement scope to the technical deep dive.

— DPA: happy to accept a 30-day subprocessor notification window; procurement, please send your marked DPA and we'll respond in our standard SLA window (3 business days for contract review for customers at this stage).

Confirming Wed 14 Apr 10:00-11:00 PDT for the technical deep dive — I've sent a calendar invite to the addresses you provided. Links: HubSpot deal FE-2319 and initial NDA/DocuSign route: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FE-2319 and https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/abcd-efgh-2027

If that's good, we'll include a short 20-minute overview and then a 30-minute technical Q&A with Marissa and Rishi.

Cheers,
Diego
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
